whyMe.title: Why hire me?
whyMe.question: Why hire me?

answer.text: Short answer: **I love creating, no matter the stack.** My goal is solving problems and having an impact, so I'll learn whatever it takes.
Good development is **more than writing code**. It's about everything else that comes with the job:
**Shipping and performing under real pressure**, tight deadlines and high standards.
**Details aren't a nice-to-have.** I care about the end user more than anything: the devil is in the details, and so am I.
**Being good with people, not just with code.** That's how I grew my father's business to 100k+ followers on TikTok and 90k+ subscribers on YouTube; millions of views and likes across both.
**Analyzing the problem before executing**, always looking for the best possible solution.
And that's just the tip of the iceberg.
answer.link: Let's get to know each other better
